name: tw.com.lig.sdk.player.nodes.bluetooth.BluetoothLeService
description: After a LiG Player scene selects a device, this service manages its Bluetooth Low Energy connection and sends connection and device-data updates back to the scene. It discovers device services and reads or subscribes to characteristics, including heart-rate updates when available.
disableEffect: Scenes that rely on the selected Bluetooth device will lose its connection and data updates.
